response.answer: Dr. Alex Smith is a leading researcher in scalable Gaussian processes, known for his work on discontinuities and scalability in multidimensional response surfaces, highly cited in 2026. He received the Doc Brown Futures Award for excellence in physics education.

results.title: [PDF] Thank You to AAPT's Partners
results.content: The Doc Brown Futures Award recognizes early-career members who demonstrate excellence in their contributions to AAPT and physics education and exhibit the potential to serve in an AAPT leadership role 4 2026 AAPT Winter Meeting Awards Rhett Allain to Receive Richtmyer Memorial Lecture Award Dr. Allain is recognized “For his exceptional ability to communicate physics to broad and diverse audiences, his innovative use of books, digital media, and public platforms to inspire curiosity about how the world works, and his sustained commitment to mentoring teachers and students while advancing excellence in teaching and scholar­ ship.” Allain joined AAPT in 1997 and has served locally in the Louisiana Section and nationally as a Section Representative, Membership & Benefits Committee member.

results.title: News - TTIC
results.content: Ph.D. candidate Ju-Chieh Chou, TTIC research faculty alumnus Professor Jiawei Zhou (Stony Brook University), and Professor Karen Livescu received the Best Student Paper award at the 2025 IEEE Automatic Speech Recognition and Understanding Workshop (ASRU) for their paper, “Flow-SLM: Joint Learning of Linguistic and Acoustic Information for Spoken Language Modeling.” The 2025 Chicago Junior Theorists Workshop, an annual workshop spotlighting junior researchers across theoretical computer science, will take place December 8–9, jointly hosted by Northwestern University and the Toyota Technological Institute at Chicago (TTIC). On September 22, 2025, the Toyota Technological Institute at Chicago (TTIC) held its annual Diploma and Awards Ceremony at The Study on the University of Chicago campus, recognizing the achievements of its graduating students. Under his leadership, TTIC developed active research and education programs in fundamental computer science, became accredited to grant PhD degrees, and is active in the recruitment of outstanding graduate students and faculty.
